description: List the layers of a Baltimore ArcGIS service (for discovery). Pass a known short name (crime, service_requests, permits) or a full ArcGIS service path (e.g. "311_Customer_Service_Requests_current/FeatureServer"). Omit `service` to list the known Baltimore services. Returns layer id + name to use with baltimore_query.

service.description: Short name (crime|service_requests|permits) or full ArcGIS service path. Omit to list known services.

name: baltimore_layers
title: Baltimore Layers
